description: This file defines the code-behind class for the 'TakenCourses' webpage in an online examination system. It contains event handlers for various button clicks that navigate to different pages within the application.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'TakenCourses' ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing navigation button event handlers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does not perform any operations.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Home' button click; redirects to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Profile' button click; redirects to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Leaderboard' button click; redirects to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Logout' button click; redirects to the LoginPage.
